title: Service Coordinator - Entwicklung zum Service Account Manager (m/w/d)
description: Diese Position ist für unsere Gesellschaft mentIQ GmbH zu besetzen. Du hältst gerne die Fäden zusammen, kommunizierst verbindlich und möchtest dich im IT-Service Schritt für Schritt weiterentwickeln? Dann übernimm bei uns eine Schlüsselrolle zwischen Kunden, Technik, Vertrieb und Herstellern. Seit 2007 steht mentIQ für intelligentes Datenmanagement, individuelle Lösungen und persönlichen Service. Als Teil der Medialine Group verbinden wir die Nähe und kurzen Wege eines spezialisierten Teams mit den Möglichkeiten einer größeren Unternehmensgruppe. Aufgaben In dieser neu geschaffenen Position arbeitest du eng mit unserer erfahrenen Service Account Managerin zusammen und berichtest direkt an unseren CIO und Leiter Technik. Zu Beginn übernimmst du vor allem koordinative und organisatorische Aufgaben. Mit wachsender Erfahrung führst du eigene Service-Themen und meisterst zunehmend auch anspruchsvolle Kundensituationen. Was du bei uns bewegst Service & Delivery koordinieren: Du entlastest unsere technischen Consultants bei organisatorischen Aufgaben, pflegst Einsätze und Projekte im CRM, holst bei Bedarf Tätigkeitsberichte ein und prüfst vor Projektstart, ob Equipment und Lizenzen bereitstehen. Projekte verlässlich begleiten: Du koordinierst Übergaben und Kick-offs, pflegst Projekt- und Einsatzpläne, verfolgst Meilensteine, unterstützt bei der Übergabe an den Kunden und holst Rückmeldungen zur Kundenzufriedenheit ein. Kundenkommunikation aktiv mitgestalten: Du koordinierst regelmäßige Service-Meetings, bereitest aussagekräftige Präsentationen und Statusübersichten vor und verfolgst die vereinbarten Maßnahmen bis zum Abschluss. CRM- und Asset-Daten verantworten: Du übernimmst die zentrale Anlage, Aktualisierung und Qualitätssicherung der technischen Kunden-Assets im CRM. Dazu gehören Informationen zu Hardware, Software, Konfigurationen, Services, Laufzeiten, Wartungsverträgen und SLAs. Damit schaffst du eine verlässliche Datengrundlage für die Serviceerbringung und anstehende Wartungsverlängerungen. Tickets aktiv nachverfolgen: Du prüfst offene, geschlossene und länger laufende Support-Tickets, holst Statusinformationen ein und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt. Serviceleistungen und Kontingente koordinieren: Du behältst vereinbarte Dienstleistungskontingente und noch offene Leistungen im Blick, vergleichst geplante mit bereits erbrachten Leistungen und stellst die notwendigen Informationen für Auftragsabwicklung und Abrechnung bereit. In Verantwortung hineinwachsen: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Service-Meetings, koordinierst Eskalationen und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden. Qualifikation Passender Hintergrund: Eine kaufmännische, serviceorientierte oder administrative Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung – entscheidend ist, dass du organisieren und mit Menschen arbeiten kannst. Struktur und Verbindlichkeit: Du arbeitest sorgfältig, setzt Prioritäten, hältst Zusagen nach und bleibst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen handlungsfähig. Kommunikationsstärke: Du formulierst klar, freundlich und lösungsorientiert – intern ebenso wie gegenüber Kunden und Partnern. Interesse an IT-Services: Du möchtest technische Zusammenhänge verstehen, musst aber zum Einstieg noch keine tiefgehende technische Expertise mitbringen. Sicherer Umgang mit Werkzeugen: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Microsoft Office; Erfahrung mit CRM-, Ticket- oder Projektmanagement-Systemen ist ein Plus. Sprache: Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und kannst dich auch auf Englisch sicher mit Kunden, Herstellern und Partnern abstimmen. Benefits Persönliche Einarbeitung: Du lernst direkt an der Seite unserer Service Account Managerin und arbeitest eng mit dem CIO sowie unserem Technik- und Vertriebsteam zusammen. Ein echter Entwicklungspfad: Du startest mit klar umrissenen Aufgaben und übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung – bis hin zur eigenständigen Betreuung von Services und Kunden. Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Teil eines wachsenden Servicebereichs kannst du Abläufe, Datenqualität und Kundenerlebnis sichtbar mitgestalten. Abwechslung und Wirkung: Bei dir laufen Informationen zusammen. Damit hilfst du, Projekte verlässlich umzusetzen, Probleme schneller zu lösen und Kunden langfristig zu begeistern. Dein Weg in der Rolle Zum Einstieg: Koordination, CRM- und Datenpflege, Meetingvorbereitung und konsequentes Nachhalten. Mit wachsender Erfahrung: Eigene Arbeitspakete, Service-Meetings sowie Verantwortung für kleinere Services und Kunden. Perspektivisch: Steuerung komplexerer Kundensituationen, Eskalationen und eigenständiges Service Account Management. Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wenn du Freude daran hast, Menschen, Aufgaben und Informationen zusammenzubringen, findest du bei uns eine Rolle, die mit dir wächst. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. In unserer Bewerberansprache setzen wir auf das 'Du'. Solltest Du eine andere Ansprache bevorzugen, lass es uns einfach wissen und wir passen uns Deinen Präferenzen an. title: Applied Operations Research Engineer
description: We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people. Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models. We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved. Your mission Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job. We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Our engine turns that model into one artifact that both evaluates like a spreadsheet and optimizes like a solver. It sits between two worlds: the mathematics that makes the answer correct, and the product that has to make it usable by people who are not mathematicians. That bridge is your mission. You work with our math and OR team to translate real customer problems into models, and you develop the engine that runs them. We will not sugarcoat it: combinatorial search is unpredictable, customer data arrives messy, and some weeks a deadline sets the priority. What you'll own Customer models, end to end.  Turn a planning problem, with its capacities, costs, lead times and shift plans, into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. That includes the data it runs on: ERP and Excel exports, and catching the numbers that cannot be right before the customer does. The interface between software and mathematics.  Our engineers, and eventually our customers, build and extend models without needing us in the room. That means deciding where the abstraction belongs and what the modeling vocabulary has to cover, then building it and keeping it standing. Answers people can act on.  A planner watches the number improve, can defend it in a meeting weeks later, and still gets something usable when the honest answer is "impossible": which rules collide, and what it would cost to bend one. Scale in both directions.  A model that answers for one site still answers when it covers twelve, over more periods, against harder constraints. And a hundred customers solving at once, none of them noticing each other. How you get there is your call. Your features from first line to production.  Nobody hands you a ticket and waits. How we work Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your work end to end: you build it, you ship it to production yourself, you run it. Feedback runs both ways and continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals, communicate proactively, and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job. We review each other's work, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room. Modeling and engine work sit in the same person here by design. Requirements You have modeled and shipped combinatorial optimization in industry (MILP, CP, or both), with models that survived messy data, deadlines and real users. Algorithm design you have actually shipped: you know where methods and solvers reach their limits, CP-SAT and Gurobi included, and you can say which technique bought you what, from warm starts and rolling horizon to relax-and-fix, aggregation, matheuristics, or a plain heuristic when an exact solve is the wrong tool. You have run optimization workloads where someone was waiting on the answer, not only in notebooks: cancellation, timeouts and parallel solves are problems you have already solved once. Python at production quality: tests, types, review, and a profiler before an optimizer. You know how numerics go wrong where a model meets a solver: scaling, tolerances, integrality, and the moment money stops fitting in an integer. You want to understand the customer's problem and their data, not only the model. You have worked in a team, not mostly alone. German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English. NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit. Nice to have: solver internals · performance work on numerical or compiled code · DSL or compiler work · production planning, supply chain or logistics domain knowledge. You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far. This role is not for you if you want research freedom over product deadlines, if you would rather rewrite an engine than measure it, if you want to work only inside your own abstraction, if the data work is someone else's job, or if you are waiting for the next task to be handed to you. Benefits Impact.  Your models decide how factories plan, on real industrial data, in a product people use daily, not a benchmark set. Customers measure in euros what your work changed, and they tell you. Ownership.  No approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's. The people next to you.  The math and OR team on the engine, and the CTO on the platform. Feedback speed.  You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you. High stakes.  Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development. The basics.  Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket. Process: a 20-minute first call with me; a technical conversation with me and someone from the math and OR team; a hands-on challenge of about three hours, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it; then the team, online and then in person. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly. To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about a model you built that made it into production, and one modeling decision in it you would reverse today. "Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period. title: Werkstudent:in Customer Success & Sales im Startup
description: Die NILS Software GmbH macht CO₂-Bilanzen und Klimastrategien für die Wohnungswirtschaft leicht – auch ohne umfassenden eigenen Datenbestand. Mit unserer Software co2pilot ermöglichen wir kleinen und mittleren Wohnungsunternehmen, Genossenschaften und kommunalen Wohnungsbauern eine belastbare CO₂-Bilanzierung ihres Portfolios und die Entwicklung szenarienbasierter Klimapfade. Was uns als Arbeitgeber auszeichnet: Sinnstiftendes Arbeiten: Du leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zur Dekarbonisierung des Gebäudesektors – einem der größten Hebel im Kampf gegen den Klimawandel. Partnerschaftlich & familiär: Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – intern wie mit unseren Kund:innen. Flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Start-up mit Substanz: Gegründet 2023, mit starken Partnern (u. a. VNW, Initiative Wohnen.2050, Vodafone) und einem multidisziplinären Team aus Software-Entwicklung, Energieingenieurwesen und Data Science. Du gestaltest mit: Bei uns bist du nicht „nur Werkstudent". Du bist an zwei zentralen Stellen unterwegs, der Neukundengewinnung und der Betreuung bestehender Kund:innen, und siehst direkt, was dein Beitrag bewirkt. Aufgaben Als Werkstudent:in Customer Success & Sales bist du an zwei Fronten aktiv: Du hilfst uns, neue Kund:innen aus der Wohnungswirtschaft für den co2pilot zu gewinnen, und du sorgst dafür, dass bestehende Kund:innen mit unserer Software gut zurechtkommen und langfristig zufrieden bleiben. Kundenansprache vorbereiten: Du recherchierst potenzielle Kund:innen (Wohnungsgenossenschaften, kommunale Wohnungsunternehmen) und bereitest individuelle Erstansprachen per E-Mail vor. Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt beim Einstieg neuer Kund:innen in den co2pilot, von der ersten Einrichtung bis zu den ersten Fragen im Tagesgeschäft. Kund:innen im Blick behalten: Du pflegst unser CRM, dokumentierst Kontaktverläufe und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn ein Kunde Unterstützung braucht oder ein Lead durchs Raster zu fallen droht. Termine koordinieren: Du vereinbarst Demo-Termine, Erstgespräche, Check-ins mit Bestandskund:innen und stimmst Kalender zwischen uns und unseren Ansprechpartner:innen ab. Fragen beantworten: Du beantwortest einfachere Kundenanfragen direkt oder leitest sie an die richtige Stelle im Team weiter. Follow-up & Nachfassen: Du bereitest Wiedervorlagen vor, sowohl im Vertrieb als auch bei bestehenden Kund:innen, und unterstützt das Team dabei, Gespräche zum richtigen Zeitpunkt wieder aufzunehmen. Materialien aufbereiten: Du hilfst bei der Anpassung von Vertriebsunterlagen, Onboarding-Guides und Mailings für konkrete Situationen. Schnittstelle zum Marketing: Du erkennst, welche Inhalte im Vertriebs- und Kundenalltag gut funktionieren, und gibst dieses Feedback ans Marketing-Team weiter. Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in, idealerweise in einem wirtschaftlichen, kommunikations- oder nachhaltigkeitsnahen Studiengang (BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Sustainability Management, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. ä.). Du kommunizierst sicher und freundlich – schriftlich wie am Telefon – und kannst dich auf unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner:innen einstellen, vom Vorstand einer traditionsreichen Genossenschaft bis zur Nachhaltigkeitsmanagerin. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, was Kund:innen brauchen, und Lust darauf, nicht nur Neukund:innen zu gewinnen, sondern auch bestehende Kund:innen langfristig zufriedenzustellen. Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Vorgängen den Überblick. Du gehst routiniert mit MS Office (vor allem Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint) um. Erfahrungen mit einem CRM-System (z. B. HubSpot) sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast Interesse an Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit, Klimastrategie und Immobilienwirtschaft – oder bist bereit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2), Englisch auf gutem Niveau. Du kannst uns idealerweise 15–20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen, gerne auch längerfristig über mehrere Semester. Benefits Faire Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deinen Vorlesungen orientieren. Hybrides Arbeiten: Du kannst weitgehend remote arbeiten – mit der Möglichkeit, regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Bad Oldesloe vorbeizukommen. Eigenverantwortung von Tag eins: Keine reine Zuarbeit, sondern eigene Themen, an denen du wachsen kannst. Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO Rafael Sporysz zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in Vertrieb und Strategie eines wachsenden Climate-Tech-Unternehmens. Lernen am Puls eines Zukunftsmarktes: Du erlebst hautnah, wie ESG, CO₂-Bilanzierung und Klimastrategie in der Praxis funktionieren – Wissen, das in den kommenden Jahren in fast jeder Branche gefragt sein wird. Echtes Team: Wir sind ein kleines, motiviertes Team, das viel Wert auf Zuverlässigkeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und ein gutes Miteinander legt. Perspektive: Bei beidseitigem Interesse besteht die Möglichkeit, nach dem Studium in eine Festanstellung zu wechseln. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Diese Stelle ist in Berlin angesiedelt. In dieser Rolle agierst du als Event-Stratege, lokaler Community-Manager und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du prägst den lokalen „Vibe“ und verwandelst Offline-Events in wirkungsvolles Brand Advocacy und messbares Pipeline-Wachstum. Wenn du eine nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz in der Eventproduktion vorweisen kannst und für die Gastronomie-Szene brennst, brauchen wir dich in unserem Team. Deine Aufgaben Erlebnisorientierte Produktion & Durchführung: Du verantwortest die gesamte Ideenfindung, Logistik und die Durchführung lokaler Aktivierungen. Dies reicht von Frühstücks-Roundtables und Arbeits-Lunches im kleinen Kreis bis hin zu exklusiven Networking-Events für die Branche in Kunden-Locations. Aktivierung von „Local Legends“ (Anchor-Programm): Du arbeitest eng mit unseren wichtigsten bestehenden Kunden zusammen und nutzt deren Locations als „Anchor“-Standorte. Du planst und gestaltest wirkungsvolle Events, die lokale Branchen-Influencer, Top-Köche, Berater und Premium-Interessenten anziehen. Vendor- & Venue-Management: Du identifizierst, verhandelst und koordinierst lokale Locations und Dienstleister. Branchenvernetzung: Du baust starke Beziehungen zu wichtigen externen Stakeholdern, Branchenverbänden und Vordenkern der Gastronomie auf, um Lightspeed tief in der lokalen Kulinarik- und Nachtleben-Szene zu verankern. Vertriebsausrichtung (Commercial Alignment): Du arbeitest eng mit dem Field Sales-Team zusammen, um regionales Marketingmaterial hochrelevant zu halten und das Team mit Erkenntnissen und Erfolgsgeschichten aus der Praxis zu versorgen. Abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit regionalen Integrated Marketing Managern, dem Product Marketing und den Social/Content-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Event-Magie in überzeugende digitale Inhalte übersetzt wird. Erfolgsmessung (KPIs) Für uns sollte jedes Event nicht nur begeistern, sondern auch messbar das Geschäftswachstum vorantreiben. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, deine Offline-Aktivitäten direkt mit unserem digitalen Sales-Funnel zu verknüpfen: Pipeline-Attribution & ROI: Du führst ein akribisches Tracking durch, um sicherzustellen, dass jedes lokale Event, Dinner oder jede Influencer-Aktivierung direkt zur Lead-Generierung und Sales-Pipeline beiträgt. Event-Performance-Metriken: Du arbeitest mit den Integrated Marketing Managern zusammen, um klare Ziele für die Veranstaltungsteilnahme, die Kosten pro Teilnehmer und die Gästezufriedenheit nach dem Event festzulegen und zu erreichen. Datenbasiertes Reporting: Du verfasst prägnante monatliche Leistungsberichte, die aufzeigen, wie lokale Field-Marketing-Aktivitäten das regionale Sales-Momentum und die Markenbindung beschleunigen. Event-Tech-Optimierung: Du nutzt CRM-Tools, Event-Management-Plattformen und Analyse-Dashboards, um den Einfluss von Kampagnen zu messen und Erkenntnisse darüber zu gewinnen, welche städtespezifischen Taktiken den größten Hebel bieten. Das bringst du mit Nachweisliche Event-Erfahrung: 3+ Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Eventmanagement, Field Marketing oder in der Eventproduktion. Du weißt, wie man spontan Probleme löst und ein nahtloses Gästeerlebnis liefert. Leidenschaft für Gastronomie: Du fühlst dich in der Gastronomiebranche vollkommen zu Hause. Du verstehst, wie Restaurants, Bars und Veranstaltungsorte funktionieren, sprichst deren Sprache und verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk aus Betreibern oder Influencern. Field-First Mindset: Du liebst es, nicht nur im Büro zu sitzen, sondern vor Ort bei den Aktivierungen zu sein. Du verfügst über eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und zeichnest dich durch exzellentes Management in dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen aus. Strategisch & autonom: Du bist ein „Self-Starter“, der keinen starren Leitfaden braucht. Du erkennst Gelegenheiten, Communitys zusammenzubringen, erstellst dafür Business-Cases und Budgets und setzt diese einwandfrei um. Vertriebsorientiert: Du erkennst, dass Events ein entscheidender Top-of-Funnel-Treiber sind. Du weißt instinktiv, wie man ein Event-Gespräch in eine sinnvolle Discovery-Chance für unser Vertriebsteam verwandelt. Wünschenswert Tech- & CRM-Kompetenz: Erfahrung mit der Nachverfolgung der Kampagnenwirkung in Enterprise-Tools wie Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo oder Looker. Attribution-Know-how: Erfahrung mit der Nutzung von UTM-Links, trackbaren QR-Codes und digitalen Landingpages zur Messung des Physical-to-Digital-Engagements. The Team

Document-oriented workloads are at the heart of many modern applications, and in this role you’ll help shape how developers build them using Redis. You will own and evolve Redis’s document data capabilities, enabling developers to work with JSON-based application data in a fast, intuitive, and scalable way across a wide range of real-world use cases.

You’ll work on a highly visible and deeply technical product area, collaborating closely with experienced engineers, architects, and customer-facing teams. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis.</p> <p>MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—whether through our work alongside exceptional teammates or through unforgettable experiences for millions of players. We're a global team of game makers building one of the world's most successful live-service games.</p> <p>As the Production Director – Seasonal Content, you'll own the operational health, planning, and execution behind MONOPOLY GO!'s seasonal content portfolio. You'll partner across Art, Design, Product, Live Operations, Licensing, and Content teams to ensure every season delivers exceptional quality, creative novelty, operational excellence, and measurable player impact.</p> <p>Success in this role goes beyond shipping content on schedule. You'll be accountable for the health of the seasonal ecosystem—including content capacity, creative ambition, production predictability, IP integration, execution quality, and the cross-functional alignment required to consistently deliver industry-leading live-service seasons.</p> <p>This role requires an exceptional balance of strategic leadership and tactical execution. You'll be equally comfortable shaping long-term organizational strategy with senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves with producers, artists, designers, and engineers to solve production challenges, unblock teams, and improve execution day-to-day.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.</li> <li>Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.</li> <li>Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.</li> <li>Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.</li> <li>Be willing to get "in the weeds" with producers and development teams to remove blockers, resolve ambiguity, improve workflows, and ensure teams have what they need to succeed.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional planning for major seasonal launches, proactively identifying execution risks, staffing challenges, dependency conflicts, and operational gaps before they impact delivery.</li> <li>Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.</li> <li>Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.</li> <li>Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.</li> <li>Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.</li> <li>Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.</li> <li>Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.</li> <li>Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.</li> <li>Strong expertise in production planning, capacity planning, portfolio management, dependency mapping, forecasting, and operational excellence.</li> <li>Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.</li> <li>Outstanding diplomacy and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve conflict constructively, and build alignment across diverse disciplines without relying on direct authority.</li> <li>Experience leading organizations through meaningful operational change, including introducing new production processes, organizational structures, tools, or ways of working while driving strong adoption.</li> <li>Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>AI Capability &amp; Readiness</strong></h2> <p>We believe AI will fundamentally transform how content organizations operate. In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. You'll champion thoughtful AI adoption across the Seasonal Content organization, helping teams work faster, make better decisions, and increase creative capacity without compromising quality. We value leaders who are curious, experimental, and capable of driving organizational change as AI reshapes game development.</p> <h2><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working on category-leading live service games.</li> <li>Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.</li> <li>Experience leading globally distributed development teams.</li> <li>Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern AI productivity tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and experience applying them to production workflows.</li> <li>Experience evolving production operating models, governance frameworks, or portfolio planning processes.</li> </ul> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!&nbsp; &nbsp;We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.</p> <p>You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.</p> <p>This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.</p> <p>Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. title: Staff System Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Shape the test strategy that proves Graphcore firmware is ready for production hardware.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will lead firmware QA across Graphcore’s next-generation hardware platforms. You will verify the low level software behind boot, configuration and monitoring.</p> <p>Your tests will protect production firmware quality, from power sequencing to hardware interfaces and telemetry. You will create reliable gates for firmware used across teams and systems.</p> <p>You will design test infrastructure, build high coverage tests and debug issues with hardware and analysers. You will also guide best practice while staying close to the code.</p> <p>This role needs technical breadth, embedded systems depth and calm ownership of difficult problems. You will shape how firmware quality scales at Graphcore.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join the Firmware QA team within System Software QA. The team validates low level software for complete boot, configuration and monitoring of Graphcore silicon and hardware platforms.</p> <p>Work happens close to hardware, across firmware, software and platform teams. title: Staff/Principal Logical Design Engineer
description: <h2><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h2> <p>At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.</p> <p>We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.</p> <p>To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.</p> <p>We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</p> <p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p>Working within the Logical Design team, the Staff/Principal Silicon Logical Design Engineer is responsible for a wide range of logical design tasks which require working closely with other engineers within the Silicon department. This person is responsible for helping the team deliver high quality micro-architecture specifications and RTL for Graphcore chips, and assisting the rest of the Silicon teams to ensure we can meet the company objectives for silicon delivery.</p> <p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>The Logical Design team sits within the Silicon team. We are responsible for delivering the micro-architecture and RTL design to implement the chip architecture specification for Graphcore Silicon.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></p> <ul> <li>Being part of the Logical Design team, producing high quality micro-architecture specification and RTL for Graphcore chips</li> <li>Ensuring good communication between different teams and across multiple sites</li> <li>Contributing to shared design infrastructure and flows</li> <li>Using EDA tools and the Graphcore design flow to design innovative technologies</li> <li>Contributing to block-level and chip-level checks and auditing (Linting, Synthesis, Timing Closure, CDC, RDC, Coverage)</li> <li>Working closely with Physical Design, Verification and DFT teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject</li> <li>Digital design experience in a relevant industry</li> <li>Be highly motivated, a self-starter, and a team player</li> <li>Ability to work across teams and finding solutions to problems</li> <li>Ability to solve design issues through programming, e.g. Python, Tcl</li> <li>Strong competency in SystemVerilog or VHDL</li> <li>Knowledge of digital design flows</li> <li>Capable of managing time and priorities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Processor design</li> <li>Application specific blocks</li> <li>High-speed serial interfaces</li> <li>Complex third-party IP integration</li> <li>Experience leading teams</li> <li>Arithmetic pipeline design</li> <li>Floating-point design</li> <li>Design for test</li> <li>Synthesis</li> <li>Timing Analysis</li> <li>Logical Equivalence</li> <li>Project Planning</li> <li>Power Integrity</li> <li>Silicon transistor knowledge</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Manufacturing Product Engineer
description: <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148"><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p data-start="150" data-end="240">Shape how Graphcore products move from hardware design into reliable volume manufacturing.</p> <p data-start="242" data-end="471">As Staff Manufacturing Product Engineer, you will support NPI development and volume production across complex hardware products. You will connect design, test, quality and supply chain decisions with real manufacturing outcomes.</p> <p data-start="473" data-end="671">Your work will help ensure products are manufacturable, resilient and ready for supplier capability. You will provide DfM feedback that improves PCB and system design before issues reach production.</p> <p data-start="673" data-end="878">You will work closely with contract manufacturers, especially during NPI and early volume manufacture. You will drive yield improvement, analyse production data and resolve L6 and L10 manufacturing issues.</p> <p data-start="880" data-end="1082">This role suits someone who enjoys practical engineering ownership across design and production. You will travel to Taiwan and work close to suppliers shaping next generation manufacturing technologies.</p> <p data-start="1084" data-end="1104"><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p data-start="1106" data-end="1291">You will join the Manufacturing and Technology Process team within Operations. The team works across Bristol, Cambridge and Taiwan, close to foundry, package assembly and PCBA partners.</p> <p data-start="1293" data-end="1472">Work happens through clear ownership, supplier engagement and fast feedback into design teams. You will speak up early when manufacturability, yield or capability needs attention.</p> <p data-start="1474" data-end="1667">The team values evidence, responsibility and strong cross-regional relationships. Decisions are made through engineering judgement, data and direct accountability for manufacturing performance.</p> <p data-start="1669" data-end="1691"><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <p data-start="1693" data-end="2226">· Strong fault diagnosis, problem solving and failure analysis skills, including ICT to SMT debug<br>· Thorough understanding of PCB assembly processes and lean manufacturing methodologies<br>· Working knowledge of L10 mechanical design and system build, ideally for HPC products<br>· Ability to connect silicon, package and PCB interactions into clear DfM feedback<br>· Experience using continuous improvement methods, including SPC and DOE<br>· Strong interpersonal skills for supplier-facing, cross-functional and cross-regional engineering work</p> <p data-start="2228" data-end="2476">While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p data-start="2478" data-end="2486"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-start="2488" data-end="3276">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3278" data-end="3640">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3642" data-end="3653"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p data-start="3655" data-end="3811">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p data-start="3813" data-end="3839"><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p data-start="3841" data-end="4120">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4122" data-end="4404">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4406" data-end="4728">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4730" data-end="4892" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to turn hardware design into stronger manufacturing performance, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help shape how Graphcore products are built.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Engineer (ML Engineer)
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>About the job</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Validate the ML stack that turns accelerator hardware into trusted AI performance.</p> <p class="p1">This role sits where modern ML models meet Graphcore’s software and hardware stack. You will test, benchmark and validate complex systems before they reach customers.</p> <p class="p1">Your work will expose regressions, correctness issues and performance limits across frameworks, models and execution environments. You will help teams understand what is working, what is breaking and why.</p> <p class="p1">You will run open source models, build automated benchmarking pipelines and create targeted tests for low level ML behaviour. That includes numerical precision, quantisation, attention mechanisms, distributed execution and model subgraphs.</p> <p class="p1">This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to how AI systems really work. You will not design new models, but you will make them run reliably on ambitious infrastructure.</p> <h3 class="p1">The team and culture</h3> <p class="p1">The ML QA team is where Graphcore’s ML software stack comes together for validation. Work spans unit tests, full model benchmarks, distributed workloads, simulators, emulators and hardware targets.</p> <p class="p1">Engineers are expected to take ownership, question assumptions and improve how testing is done. The team moves quickly, but decisions are grounded in evidence, benchmark data and technical discussion.</p> <p class="p1">You will work closely with software, infrastructure and hardware teams. Squads organise around priorities, with space for engineers to shape roadmaps and raise the quality bar.</p> <h3 class="p1">What we’re looking for</h3> <p class="p1">· Strong experience in Machine Learning or ML-adjacent software engineering roles.<br>· A solid grasp of neural networks, training, inference, numerical precision and performance trade-offs.<br>· Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Triton or similar ML frameworks and tools.<br>· Strong Python skills for automation, experimentation, benchmarking and reporting.<br>· Experience designing, running and analysing ML benchmarks or model experiments.<br>· Confident debugging skills in Linux, with curiosity about model behaviour and system performance.</p> <h3 class="p1">Benefits</h3> <p class="p1">· Unlimited annual leave<br>· Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity – share in Graphcore’s success<br>· True flexibility in how and where you work<br>· Office spaces designed for collaboration<br>· Free food and an on-site barista<br>· Health cash plan<br>· Income protection<br>· Life assurance<br>· Along with other benefits you can choose from (private medical insurance, dental plan etc)</p> <p class="p1">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p class="p1">We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3 style="text-align: left;">Join the Team at Graphcore</h3> <p style="text-align: left;">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of&nbsp;companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies.&nbsp;Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and&nbsp;ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range&nbsp;of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon&nbsp;designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together&nbsp;deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI&nbsp;compute.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">If you want to validate the systems behind next generation AI compute, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help build what comes next.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h3>About the job</h3> <p>Build the framework support that helps AI developers unlock Graphcore hardware.</p> <p>You will help Graphcore accelerators work seamlessly with state-of-the-art ML frameworks, including Triton and PyTorch. You will also manage hardware resources, develop packaging solutions and improve CI/CD pipelines.</p> <p>This role gives you direct exposure to low level software, hardware and cross-team integration. description: <h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148">About the job</h3> <p data-start="150" data-end="238">Shape the SoC architecture behind Graphcore’s next generation AI acceleration platforms.&nbsp;Graphcore is building AI compute systems that push far beyond a single chip. As a SoC Architect, you will define, specify and integrate critical subsystems for complex silicon devices.&nbsp;You will work across processor, SoC and system architecture to turn product requirements into practical design choices. Your work will influence performance, integration, modelling, validation and bring-up.&nbsp;This role is for someone who enjoys deep technical ownership and broad system context. You will help Graphcore deliver multiple AI silicon projects in parallel, at real scale.&nbsp;You will work on interfaces, interconnects and SoC subsystems that sit at the centre of advanced AI platforms. The problems are complex, visible and difficult to find elsewhere.</p> <p data-start="990" data-end="1010">&nbsp;</p> <h3 data-start="990" data-end="1010">The team and culture</h3> <p data-start="1012" data-end="1196">The Silicon Architecture team sits at the point where product ambition becomes silicon reality. title: Senior Software Engineer (ML QA)
description: <h3 class="p1">About the job</h3> <p class="p1">Help prove the ML software stack that future AI systems will depend on.&nbsp;Graphcore is expanding the software systems behind AI compute at datacenter scale. This role focuses on validating a complex machine learning stack before it reaches customers and hardware.You will build the test infrastructure, automation and tooling that engineers trust every day. Your work will help raise reliability, performance and maintainability across frameworks, simulators, emulators and future hardware.&nbsp;You will shape test architecture across large codebases, CI pipelines and representative ML workloads. You will use strong software engineering judgement to turn complex technical goals into scalable validation systems.</p> <p class="p1">This is a role for someone who enjoys depth, ownership and useful engineering. You will make quality easier, faster and more visible for teams building at the edge of AI compute.</p> <h3 class="p1">The team and culture</h3> <p class="p1">The ML QA team sits where Graphcore’s software components come together. Engineers work across unit tests, integration tests, full model runs, subgraph validation and benchmarking.</p> <p class="p1">Work is organised through focused squads with clear ownership. People are expected to step up, speak openly and improve how the team builds, tests and learns.</p> <p class="p1">Decisions are grounded in evidence from code, data and system behaviour. The team works closely with software teams to identify gaps, improve tooling and move priorities forward quickly.</p> <h3 class="p1">What we’re looking for</h3> <p class="p1">· Strong software design skills, with experience building maintainable systems across large codebases.<br>· Production Python experience, including testable, reliable code used by other engineers.<br>· Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and Linux based development workflows.<br>· Familiarity with C or C++, with confidence reading and debugging low level code.<br>· Understanding of ML frameworks, workloads or model execution beyond simple API usage.<br>· Ability to mentor engineers, improve practices and take ownership of complex technical problems.</p> <h3 class="p1">Benefits</h3> <p class="p1">· Unlimited annual leave<br>· Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity – share in Graphcore’s success<br>· True flexibility in how and where you work<br>· Office spaces designed for collaboration<br>· Free food and an on-site barista<br>· Health cash plan<br>· Income protection<br>· Life assurance<br>· Along with other benefits you can choose from (private medical insurance, dental plan etc)<br>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p class="p1">We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3 class="p1">Join the team at Graphcore<br><br></h3> <p class="p1">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence&nbsp;compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will&nbsp;unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread&nbsp;adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p class="p1">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of&nbsp;companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies.&nbsp;Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and&nbsp;ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p class="p1">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range&nbsp;of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon&nbsp;designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together&nbsp;deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI&nbsp;compute.</p> <p class="p1">If you want to shape how complex ML software is tested, trusted and improved, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Own the tests that prove Graphcore’s driver software is ready for real systems.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you will verify and validate complex device drivers and tools. Your work will support Graphcore’s next-generation products from early development to production release.</p> <p>You will design, implement, execute and report high quality tests across kernel drivers, user space libraries and platform tools. You will also strengthen test infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines that support reliable software delivery.</p> <p>This role sits close to the hardware and reaches up the stack. You will help uncover hard issues, reduce MTBF and build confidence in every release.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join the Drivers QA team within System Software QA. The team tests low level kernel drivers, user space libraries and platform tools.</p> <p>Work happens across the full stack, from hardware and firmware to ML, Kubernetes and cloud management. You will partner early with developers and turn real use cases into component, integration and acceptance tests.</p> <p>Decisions are made through technical discussion, evidence and ownership. You will speak up in reviews, improve ways of working and help junior engineers raise their impact.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Experience validating Linux kernel and/or device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using C++ and Python.<br>· Experience with CI/CD, build tools and modern testing practices.<br>· Strong debugging skills across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Ability to develop integration and acceptance test plans from real use cases.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to document decisions and mentor others.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. title: Senior Semiconductor Reliability Engineer – Advanced Silicon & Packaging
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Own the reliability strategy behind advanced AI silicon built for datacenter scale.</p> <p>Graphcore is expanding the hardware platforms that will power the next generation of AI compute. As Senior Semiconductor Reliability Engineer, you will lead reliability strategy across advanced silicon nodes and packaging technologies.</p> <p>You will shape reliability from technology selection and design enablement through bring-up, qualification and manufacturing. Your work will help complex, high-performance devices move from ambitious design into robust production.</p> <p>You will assess risk, guide sign-off, lead qualification and drive failure analysis across silicon, interconnect and package technologies. This is a rare role at the centre of device physics, design, packaging and manufacturing.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will work across silicon, packaging, manufacturing and quality, connecting technical detail with product-level decisions. Work moves through direct ownership, clear evidence and fast escalation when risks need attention.</p> <p>Decisions are grounded in data, modelling, qualification results and open technical debate. You will be expected to speak up, challenge assumptions and turn complex findings into clear next steps.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who thinks beyond individual tests. You will help build stronger reliability methods and mentor others as Graphcore scales advanced AI hardware platforms.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field<br>· Strong semiconductor reliability experience across silicon, BEOL, interconnect or advanced package technologies<br>· Deep understanding of mechanisms such as EM, TDDB, BTI and HCI<br>· Hands-on experience with HTOL, thermal cycling, thermal shock, reflow testing and JEDEC reliability standards<br>· Ability to use X-ray and CSAM analysis to diagnose package defects and support root-cause analysis<br>· Strong technical judgement, communication skills and ownership across foundries, OSATs, labs and internal teams</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>We offer sponsorship for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>If you want to shape the reliability foundations of advanced AI silicon at Graphcore, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Large Systems)
description: <h2><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h2> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <p><strong>Job Summary</strong><strong> </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in the Applied AI team at Graphcore, you will contribute to advancing AI technology by developing and optimising AI models tailored to our specialised hardware. You will work on large scale systems where performance is critical to the success of our projects. Working closely with the Software development and Research teams, you will play a critical role in identifying opportunities to innovate and differentiate Graphcore’s technology. We seek engineers with strong technical skills and an understanding of AI model implementation at scale, eager to make a tangible impact in this rapidly evolving field.</p> <p><strong><br>The Team</strong></p> <p>The Applied AI team’s role is to be proxies for our customers, we need to understand the latest AI models, applications, and software to ensure that Graphcore’s technology works seamlessly with the AI ecosystem and at scale. We build reference applications, contribute to key software libraries e.g. optimising kernels for efficiency on our hardware, and collaborate with the Research team to develop and publish novel ideas in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications.<br><br>If you're excited about advancing the next generation of AI models on cutting-edge hardware, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement latest machine learning models and optimise them for performance and accuracy, scaling to 1000s of accelerators.</li> <li>Test and evaluate new internal software releases, provide feedback to software engineering teams, make necessary code fixes, and conduct code reviews.</li> <li>Benchmark models and key ML techniques to identify performance bottlenecks and improve model efficiency.</li> <li>Design and conduct experiments on novel AI methods, implement them and evaluate results.</li> <li>Collaborate with Research, Software, and Product teams to define, build, and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</li> <li>Engage with AI community and keep in touch with the latest developments in AI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp; </strong></p> <p><strong>Candidate Profile </strong><br><strong><br>Essential:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor/Master's/PhD or equivalent experience in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Maths, Data Science, or related field.</li> <li>Proficiency in deep learning frameworks like PyTorch/JAX.</li> <li>Strong Python or C++ software development skills</li> <li>Expertise in deep learning from model training to optimisation and evaluation.</li> <li>Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.</li> <li>Developed deep understanding of performance bottlenecks and how to overcome them.</li> <li>Ability to move quickly in a dynamic environment</li> <li>Enjoy cross-functional work collaborating with other teams.</li> <li>Strong communicator - able to explain complex technical concepts to different audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in one or more of: <ul> <li>MLOps for Kubernetes-based clusters</li> <li>Building production systems with large language models</li> <li>Efficient computing based on low-precision arithmetic.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience writing C++/Triton/CUDA kernels for performance optimisation of ML models.</li> <li>Experience in distributed training or inference of ML models across 64+ accelerators.</li> <li>Familiarity with HPC systems and networking including Infiniband, NVLink, RoCE technologies.</li> <li>Have contributed to open-source projects or published research papers in relevant fields.</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud computing platforms.</li> <li>Keen to present, publish and deliver talks in the AI community.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p>Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Engineer (ML Engineer)
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>About the job</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Validate the ML stack that turns accelerator hardware into trusted AI performance.</p> <p class="p1">This role sits where modern ML models meet Graphcore’s software and hardware stack. You will test, benchmark and validate complex systems before they reach customers.</p> <p class="p1">Your work will expose regressions, correctness issues and performance limits across frameworks, models and execution environments. You will help teams understand what is working, what is breaking and why.</p> <p class="p1">You will run open source models, build automated benchmarking pipelines and create targeted tests for low level ML behaviour. That includes numerical precision, quantisation, attention mechanisms, distributed execution and model subgraphs.</p> <p class="p1">This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to how AI systems really work. You will not design new models, but you will make them run reliably on ambitious infrastructure.</p> <h3 class="p1">The team and culture</h3> <p class="p1">The ML QA team is where Graphcore’s ML software stack comes together for validation. Work spans unit tests, full model benchmarks, distributed workloads, simulators, emulators and hardware targets.</p> <p class="p1">Engineers are expected to take ownership, question assumptions and improve how testing is done. The team moves quickly, but decisions are grounded in evidence, benchmark data and technical discussion.</p> <p class="p1">You will work closely with software, infrastructure and hardware teams. Squads organise around priorities, with space for engineers to shape roadmaps and raise the quality bar.</p> <h3 class="p1">What we’re looking for</h3> <p class="p1">· Strong experience in Machine Learning or ML-adjacent software engineering roles.<br>· A solid grasp of neural networks, training, inference, numerical precision and performance trade-offs.<br>· Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Triton or similar ML frameworks and tools.<br>· Strong Python skills for automation, experimentation, benchmarking and reporting.<br>· Experience designing, running and analysing ML benchmarks or model experiments.<br>· Confident debugging skills in Linux, with curiosity about model behaviour and system performance.</p> <h3 class="p1">Benefits</h3> <p class="p1">· Unlimited annual leave<br>· Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity – share in Graphcore’s success<br>· True flexibility in how and where you work<br>· Office spaces designed for collaboration<br>· Free food and an on-site barista<br>· Health cash plan<br>· Income protection<br>· Life assurance<br>· Along with other benefits you can choose from (private medical insurance, dental plan etc)</p> <p class="p1">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p class="p1">We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <h3 style="text-align: left;">Join the Team at Graphcore</h3> <p style="text-align: left;">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of&nbsp;companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies.&nbsp;Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and&nbsp;ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range&nbsp;of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon&nbsp;designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together&nbsp;deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI&nbsp;compute.</p> <p style="text-align: left;">If you want to validate the systems behind next generation AI compute, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help build what comes next.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
