title: Principal Software Architect
description: <h2><strong>About Graphcore&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Graphcore&nbsp;is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. &nbsp;</p> <p>It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. &nbsp;</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group,&nbsp;Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. &nbsp;</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are looking for a Principal Architect to define and drive the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.</p> <p>In this role, you will shape the architecture of our software ecosystem and maintain a deep understanding of the product’s hardware and software components, their interfaces, and how they interact.</p> <p>You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey the software architecture.</p> <p>You bring a pragmatic, trade-off-aware approach to decision-making, fully recognising the impact of architectural choices on product direction and engineering outcomes.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The Team</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.</p> <p>The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define &amp; document the software architecture of the software stack. &nbsp;</li> <li>Work across different software domains to ensure a coherent end too end architecture.</li> <li>Clearly communicate the software architecture to engineering teams.</li> <li>Ensure teams understand key software architectural components, interfaces, and guiding principles.&nbsp;</li> <li>Continuously maintain the software architecture as the product evolves. Communicate architectural changes proactively to all relevant stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.</li> <li>Assess the architectural impact of new technologies.</li> <li>Be aware of the usability, performance, reliability, maintainability, testability, security and observability constraints on the software architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Prototyping and validating architectural concepts through proof-of-concept implementations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Contribute to future and/or related product definitions with a forward-looking mindset, understanding and communicating the impact of future direction on software architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work with the HW and Silicon architects to ensure product the needs of software stack.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure the software architecture meets the product requirements. &nbsp;</li> <li>Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural direction.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C &amp; C++, CPU architectures.</li> <li>Technical expertise in the ML accelerator software space.</li> <li>Excellent communication skill, both written and verbal.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to influence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p><em>Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> </li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Engineer
description: <p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="135" data-end="148"><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p data-start="150" data-end="247">Turn complex manufacturing data into higher yield, stronger quality and better products at scale.</p> <p data-start="249" data-end="481">As Principal Product Engineer, you will help Graphcore manufacture advanced products with optimised yield, quality and cost. You will guide product performance through launch, production ramp and sustained high volume manufacturing.</p> <p data-start="483" data-end="663">Your work will influence chip manufacturing, test, PCBA and system level production. You will help teams find the signals that improve reliability, reduce cost and protect quality.</p> <p data-start="665" data-end="875">You will partner with OSATs, test engineering, manufacturing, quality, data engineering and analytics teams. Together, you will release new products and solve difficult yield, test and manufacturing challenges.</p> <p data-start="877" data-end="1058">This role suits someone who enjoys deep technical ownership and practical impact. You will turn manufacturing data into action across silicon, boards, blades and rack scale systems.</p> <p data-start="1060" data-end="1080"><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p data-start="1082" data-end="1276">You will join the Product Test and Diagnosis team within Manufacturing Operations. The team spans Bristol, Cambridge, India, the US and Taiwan, working close to products and production partners.</p> <p data-start="1278" data-end="1462">Work happens through direct ownership, technical depth and clear decisions. You will define best practice, challenge assumptions and move quickly when yield or quality needs attention.</p> <p data-start="1464" data-end="1653">The team connects silicon, board level assemblies, server blades and rack scale systems. Decisions are grounded in data, engineering judgement and accountability for manufacturing outcomes.</p> <p data-start="1655" data-end="1677"><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <p data-start="1679" data-end="2328">· Strong semiconductor product engineering, test engineering or manufacturing engineering capability in high volume production<br>· Deep understanding of semiconductor, PCBA and system level manufacturing and testing<br>· Strong statistical analysis skills, including SPC, DOE, regression, hypothesis testing and six sigma methods<br>· Proven ability to analyse and visualise large manufacturing datasets using Python, SQL, JMP or similar tools<br>· Experience driving yield, quality or cost improvements across complex manufacturing processes<br>· Ability to work across test, manufacturing, quality, data and external partner teams with clear technical ownership</p> <p data-start="2330" data-end="2578">While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p data-start="2580" data-end="2588"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-start="2590" data-end="3378">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3380" data-end="3742">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3744" data-end="3755"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p data-start="3757" data-end="3913">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p data-start="3915" data-end="3941"><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p data-start="3943" data-end="4222">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4224" data-end="4506">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p data-start="4508" data-end="4830">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p data-start="4832" data-end="4990" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you want to turn manufacturing insight into better products at scale, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to help shape product engineering at Graphcore.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Atlassian Cloud Platform Engineer
description: <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.</span></p> <p><span data-teams="true">We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.</span></p> <p><span data-teams="true">As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence</span>.</p> <h2>Job Summary</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly experienced Lead Atlassian Cloud Platform Engineer to own our Atlassian Cloud ecosystem. This includes multiple sites and environments used for cross-company collaboration.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>This role is responsible for maintaining the architectural integrity, security stance, and scalable expansion of the Atlassian platform. An important part of this position involves creating and managing a configuration-as-code environment. In this setup, platform settings are handled via APIs, pipelines, and source control instead of manual management, which guarantees consistency, traceability, and adherence across all locations.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>You will serve as the primary platform owner, setting standards, ensuring governance, and promoting self-service features that help teams work efficiently while keeping security and configuration intact.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Collaborating with Project Managers, engineering teams, and partners, you will build scalable workflows. You will also guide platform growth and ensure the Atlassian environment adapts to the organisation’s changing requirements.</p> <p>This role begins with an active role that includes daily support, configuration, and onboarding efforts. At the same time, it involves growing the Atlassian platform team and setting up scalable processes.<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2>The Team</h2> <p>You’ll be joining a multi-disciplinary team with strong technical skills and a very encouraging culture. We work closely together, regularly share knowledge, and your skills will make a direct impact on our business. It’s an exciting and pivotal moment for us right now, with plenty of new projects ahead. If you're looking to solve interesting problems and see your work deliver real-world results, this is the team for you!</p> <h2>Responsibilities and Duties</h2> <ul> <li>Manage and maintain multiple Atlassian Cloud sites, ensuring secure collaboration spaces that span different companies</li> <li>Act as the authoritative decision-maker for Atlassian configuration, preventing configuration drift and ensuring architectural consistency in all builds</li> <li>Define and enforce governance standards aligned with audit, compliance, and security requirements</li> <li>Establish and maintain a configuration-as-code operating model, ensuring all configuration is provisioned and managed through source control, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Build and maintain automated identity and access provisioning, coordinated with Azure AD (or equivalent), ensuring access follows established rules and is auditable</li> <li>Lead automation efforts for project provisioning, workflows, permissions, and scheme management</li> <li>Develop and evolve self-service capabilities to standardise project setup and reduce administrative overhead</li> <li>Define and maintain best-practice configuration patterns across Jira and Confluence</li> <li>Ensure secure separation of internal and third-party collaboration environments, with awareness of data governance, export controls, and security boundaries</li> <li>Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on platform and workflow issues and implement preventative improvements</li> <li>Act as the final point of contact for complex Atlassian issues and provide enterprise-level support</li> <li>Deliver professional advice to Project Managers and engineering teams across diverse workflows and delivery models</li> <li>Provide direct assistance when needed, including collaborating with Project Managers and teams to set up projects and workflows, ensuring they align with platform standards and governance</li> <li>Coordinate identity and access integrations and drive automation of administrative processes through scripting and tooling</li> <li>Build, mentor, and grow the Atlassian platform team, defining clear roles, responsibilities, and methods of collaboration</li> <li>Proactively identify improvement opportunities and drive solutions.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>Essential:</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience coordinating Atlassian Enterprise Cloud</li> <li>Proven experience operating as a lead or primary Atlassian platform owner</li> <li>Strong automation expertise (Jira Automation, REST APIs, scripting)</li> <li>Demonstrated experience implementing configuration-as-code approaches for SaaS platforms</li> <li>Experience automating project configuration and enforcing standardisation at scale</li> <li>Strong understanding of access control based on user identity and automated provisioning models</li> <li>Experience connecting Atlassian with Azure AD (or a similar IdP)</li> <li>Experience working in audit-controlled or governance-heavy environments</li> <li>Experience crafting secure multi-tenant or cross-company collaboration environments</li> <li>Solid understanding of data governance, security boundaries, and compliance considerations</li> <li>Proficient scripting abilities (e.g. PowerShell, Python, Go) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Strong collaborator management and consultancy skills</li> <li>Proven ability to operate independently, set direction, and deliver outcomes</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable</h2> <ul> <li>Atlassian certifications</li> <li>Experience building internal self-service platforms</li> <li>Experience directing large-scale collaboration efforts across multiple companies</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps tooling and infrastructure-as-code concepts</li> <li>Experience defining enterprise-wide workflow standards</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Start your architecture career helping shape the AI chips of the future.&nbsp;Our two-year Graduate Programme is designed to give you the technical experience, support and responsibility to build a successful career in AI computing.</p> <p>As a 2026 Graduate SoC Architecture Engineer, you will help define, model and evaluate complex sub-systems for Graphcore’s next-generation AI acceleration hardware.</p> <p>You will discover how product requirements become architectural choices, develop trade-offs and silicon-ready specifications. Your work will support high-performance, highly integrated SoC designs used in advanced AI compute.</p> <p>You will contribute to specifications, modelling, simulation, validation and technical analysis. You may also support IP evaluation, silicon bring-up, testing and performance investigations.</p> <p>You do not need to arrive as an expert. We are looking for graduates with strong fundamentals, curiosity and the aim to learn from real architecture work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Team &amp; Culture</strong></p> <p>The Silicon Architecture team defines how critical SoC sub-systems behave, connect and perform. title: Director of Software Architecture
description: <h2><strong>About Graphcore&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Graphcore&nbsp;is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. &nbsp;</p> <p>It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry. &nbsp;</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group,&nbsp;Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone. &nbsp;</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation. &nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Job Summary</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Software Architect to lead the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.</p> <p>In this role, you lead an architecture team that will define the software architecture for Graphcore products.</p> <p>You are a thought leader and an advocate for our long-term technical vision, engaging with project stakeholder, external partners and customers to ensure alignment and clarity.</p> <p>You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey architectural decisions and changes as the product evolves.</p> <h2><strong>The Team</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <p>The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.</p> <p>The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Communicate the long-term technical vision &amp; strategy for the software architecture</li> <li>Define the processes and procedures to define, agree and maintain the software architecture.</li> <li>Act as an advocate and thought leader for the long-term technical vision across the organisation.</li> <li>Advocate for the user experience to ensure that the software architecture results in a software stack that is easy to use.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Manage technical and project-level architectural risks.&nbsp;</li> <li>Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural vision.&nbsp;</li> <li>Inspire, grow, mentor and develop the software architecture team.</li> <li>Clearly communicate the trade off’s for architectural decisions that have company wide impacts.</li> <li>Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a leadership role.</li> <li>Experience of working with silicon and hardware teams.</li> <li>Technical expertise in the ML accelerator software space.</li> <li>Excellent communication skill, both written and verbal.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborative mindset and ability to influence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C &amp; C++, CPU architectures.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role.&nbsp;<br><br> <h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> </li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

the job</strong></p> <p data-start="150" data-end="252">Build the product engineering capability that protects yield, quality and cost at manufacturing scale.</p> <p data-start="254" data-end="471">As Director of Product Engineering, you will lead how Graphcore products move through launch and high volume production. You will recruit and develop a team focused on semiconductor and PCBA manufacturing performance.</p> <p data-start="473" data-end="680">Your work will shape yield, quality and cost across chip manufacturing, test, PCBA and system level production. You will give teams the data, standards and direction needed to solve hard production problems.</p> <p data-start="682" data-end="902">You will work with OSATs, test engineering, manufacturing, quality, data engineering and analytics teams. You will define best practice for data collection, correlation, dashboards and self-service manufacturing insight.</p> <p data-start="904" data-end="1071">This role suits a leader who combines technical depth with team building. You will set the standard for product engineering across Graphcore’s manufacturing lifecycle.</p> <p data-start="1073" data-end="1093"><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p data-start="1095" data-end="1238">You will join the Product Test and Diagnosis team within Manufacturing Operations. The team spans Bristol, Cambridge, India, the US and Taiwan.</p> <p data-start="1240" data-end="1450">Work happens through clear technical ownership, fast issue resolution and strong links to manufacturing partners. You will lead by setting direction, removing ambiguity and building capability across locations.</p> <p data-start="1452" data-end="1646">Decisions are grounded in production data, engineering judgement and accountability for outcomes. The team values leaders who think big, act fast and speak up when quality or yield needs action.</p> <p data-start="1648" data-end="1670"><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <p data-start="1672" data-end="2245">· Extensive semiconductor product engineering, test engineering or manufacturing engineering capability<br>· Proven people leadership experience, including hiring and building teams across geographies<br>· Strong understanding of semiconductor, PCBA and system level manufacturing and testing<br>· Deep statistical analysis skills, including SPC, DOE, regression, hypothesis testing and six sigma methods<br>· Proven ability to analyse large manufacturing datasets using Python, SQL, JMP or similar tools<br>· Success driving yield, quality and cost improvements in high volume production</p> <p data-start="2247" data-end="2495">While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p data-start="2497" data-end="2505"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-start="2507" data-end="3295">· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p data-start="3297" data-end="3659">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p data-start="3661" data-end="3672"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p data-start="3674" data-end="3830">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p data-start="3832" data-end="3858"><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p data-start="3860" data-end="4139">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p data-start="4141" data-end="4423">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. title: AI Research Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h3> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p class="p1">As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the&nbsp;limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we&nbsp;believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting&nbsp;field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to&nbsp;deliver impactful AI research.&nbsp;We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference,&nbsp;world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate&nbsp;them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>The Team</h3> <p>Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.</p> <p>We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.</p> <p>Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/publications/">papers</a> or an article on our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/posts/">blog</a>. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <h3>Responsibilities and Duties</h3> <ul> <li>Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them &amp; evaluate results.</li> <li>Prepare, submit &amp; present your work to AI conferences and workshops.</li> <li>Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.</li> <li>Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About you:</h3> <p>Essential:</p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).</li> <li>Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.</li> <li>Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.</li> <li>Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.</li> <li>Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector &amp; matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.</li> <li>Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution</li> </ul> <p>Desirable:</p> <ul> <li class="p1">Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.</li> <li class="p1">Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Each hub has accessible spaces to park your laptop, is designed to inspire people, help them connect and bring big ideas to life.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Everyone belongs at OVO:</strong></p> <p>At OVO, we are on a mission to solve one of humanity's biggest challenges, the climate crisis. And we know it takes all of us to change the world. That's why we need diverse people from all abilities, gender identities, ethnicities, ages, sexual orientations, life experiences and backgrounds to join us.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Teamworking for the planet:</strong></p> <p>Everything we do here spins around <a href="https://company.ovo.com/planzero/">Plan Zero.</a> So, naturally, the team you’ll be joining plays a gigantic role in making that happen. Here’s how:</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll own the end-to-end development of complex systems and features that are core to our business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This role in a nutshell:</strong></p> <p>You will lead technical initiatives, make critical design decisions, and mentor engineers to elevate the team's capabilities. Your expertise will be the driving force that ensures we build scalable, high-quality software that pushes our company forward.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your key outcomes will be:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Architecture:</strong> Drive the architectural vision for key features, designing robust, scalable systems and contributing to the technical roadmap to influence the future direction of the product.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Excellence &amp; Quality:</strong> Champion best practices by writing clean, efficient code, leading rigorous code reviews, and implementing comprehensive automated testing to ensure high-quality, performant solutions.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship &amp; Team Growth:</strong> Lead and mentor other engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration through knowledge sharing, technical discussions, and constructive feedback.</li> <li><strong>Project Execution &amp; Delivery:</strong> Translate complex projects into clear, executable tasks within an Agile framework, proactively resolving blockers to ensure the timely and efficient delivery of team commitments.</li> <li><strong>Community &amp; Knowledge Sharing:</strong> Actively contribute to the wider engineering community by leading discussions, sharing expertise through documentation and workshops, and driving the exchange of best practices.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You’ll be successful</strong><strong>&nbsp;here</strong><strong> at OVO if you…</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Professional Experience:</strong> Significant hands-on experience developing software in an agile environment, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality, clean code.</li> <li><strong>Backend &amp; Architecture:</strong> Expertise in designing and building scalable microservices-based architectures using languages like Node.js, Python, and TypeScript.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; DevOps:</strong> Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD practices.</li> <li><strong>Frontend Development:</strong> Proficiency in modern frontend frameworks such as React.js and/or React Native.</li> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Mentorship:</strong> Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration &amp; Problem-Solving:</strong> Excellent communication and analytical skills, with the ability to thrive in a high-ownership, collaborative team environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Let’s talk about what’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>We’ll pay you between £55,000 and £84,923, depending on your specific skills and experience.</p> <p>We keep our pay ranges broad on purpose to give us, and you, flexibility to match your experience to our zero carbon mission.</p> <p>You’ll be eligible for an on-target bonus of 15%. We have one OVO bonus plan that focuses on the collective performance of our people to deliver our Plan Zero goal.&nbsp;</p> <p>We also offer plenty of green benefits and progressive policies to help you feel like you belong at OVO…and there’s flex pay. We'll give you 9% Flex Pay on top of your salary – 4% of this is auto enrolled into your pension, and the remaining 5% is yours to do what you like with. You can use this to buy from our extensive range of flexible benefits, including our green benefits which we've put at the heart of our offering, add to your pension or even take it as cash.</p> <p>Here’s a taster of what’s on offer:&nbsp;</p> <p>For starters, you’ll get 34 days of holiday (including bank holidays). <br><br><strong>For your health</strong><strong><br></strong>With benefits like a healthcare cash plan or private medical insurance depending on your career level, critical illness cover, life assurance, health assessments, and more<br><strong><br></strong><strong>For your wellbeing</strong><strong><br></strong>With gym membership, travel insurance, workplace ISA, will writing services, dental insurance, and more <strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>For your lifestyle </strong><strong><br></strong>With extra holiday buying, discount dining, home &amp; tech loans, and supporting your favourite charities with give-as-you-earn donations<br><br><strong>For your home&nbsp; </strong><strong><br></strong>Get up to £400 towards any OVO Energy plan, plus great discounts on solar, smart thermostats and EV chargers<br><strong><br></strong><strong>For your commute </strong><strong><br></strong>Nab a great deal on ultra-low emission car leasing<strong>, </strong>plus our cycle to work scheme and public transport season ticket loans <br><br>Want to hear about our full range of flexible benefits and progressive people policies? Our People Team can tell you everything you need to know.</p> <p><strong>For your Belonging</strong></p> <p>To find better ways to support our people, we need to listen to each other’s experiences and find ways to build a truly inclusive and diverse workplace. As part of this, we have 8 Belonging Networks at OVO. Led by our people, for our people - so when you join OVO, you can play a part - big or small - with any of the Networks. It's up to you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Oh, and one last thing...</strong></p> <p>We’d be thrilled if you tick off all our boxes, yet we also believe it’s just as important we tick off all of yours. And if you think you have most of what we’re looking for but not every single thing, go ahead and hit <strong>apply</strong>. We’d still love to hear from you!</p> <p>If you have any additional requirements, there’s a space to let us know on the application form; we want to make the process as easy and comfortable for you as possible.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
